probes.query: SELECT s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId AS SummaryId,s.SamplingLotId,s.SampleTestId,s.TotalSamplesCompleted,s.TotalRejects,s.TotalPassedSamples,s.HistoryId,s.HistoryMainlineId,s.TxnId,h.HistoryId AS HeaderHistoryId,h.ContainerId,h.ContainerName,h.Comments,h.TxnType,h.TxnTypeName,h.TxnServiceName,h.TxnServiceSequence,h.ReversalStatus FROM CollectSamplingDataHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId WHERE h.Comments=N'quality-history-read-only-contract-probe' AND h.ContainerId='0000000000000000' AND s.SampleTestId='0000000000000000' AND (s.SamplingLotId IS NULL OR s.SamplingLotId='') ORDER BY s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId AS SummaryId,s.SamplingLotId,s.SampleTestId,s.TotalSamplesCompleted,s.TotalRejects,s.TotalPassedSamples,s.HistoryId,s.HistoryMainlineId,s.TxnId,h.HistoryId AS HeaderHistoryId,h.ContainerId,h.ContainerName,h.Comments,h.TxnType,h.TxnTypeName,h.TxnServiceName,h.TxnServiceSequence,h.ReversalStatus FROM CollectSamplingDataHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId WHERE h.Comments=N'quality-history-read-only-contract-probe' AND h.ContainerId='0000000000000000' AND s.SampleTestId='0000000000000000' AND s.SamplingLotId='0000000000000000' ORDER BY s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.ExecuteSamplingLotHistoryId AS SummaryId,s.SamplingCompleted,s.SamplingLotResult,s.HistoryId,s.HistoryMainlineId,s.TxnId,h.HistoryId AS HeaderHistoryId,h.ContainerId,h.ContainerName,h.Comments,h.TxnType,h.TxnTypeName,h.TxnServiceName,h.TxnServiceSequence,h.ReversalStatus FROM ExecuteSamplingLotHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId WHERE h.Comments=N'quality-history-read-only-contract-probe' ORDER BY s.ExecuteSamplingLotHistoryId OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TOP 51 d.CollectSamplingHistoryDetailId AS InstanceID,d.HistoryDetailsId AS ParentId,d.HistoryId,d.TxnId,d.SampleTestId,d.SampleTestName,d.Rejected,d.Rejects FROM CollectSamplingHistoryDetails d INNER JOIN CollectSamplingDataHistory s ON d.HistoryDetailsId=s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId AND d.TxnId=s.TxnId AND d.HistoryId=s.HistoryId WHERE s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId='0000000000000000' AND s.TxnId='0000000000000000' ORDER BY d.CollectSamplingHistoryDetailId

SELECT TOP 101 p.CollectSamplingTestDtlHistorId AS InstanceID,p.HistoryDetailsId AS ParentId,p.HistoryId,p.TxnId,p.SampleDataPointId,p.DataType,p.DataValue,p.Passed,p.LowerLimit,p.UpperLimit,p.RejectReasonId,p.EnteredQty FROM CollectSamplingHistoryDetails d INNER JOIN CollectSamplingDataHistory s ON d.HistoryDetailsId=s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId AND d.TxnId=s.TxnId AND d.HistoryId=s.HistoryId INNER JOIN CollectSamplingTestDtlHistory p ON p.HistoryDetailsId=d.CollectSamplingHistoryDetailId AND p.TxnId=d.TxnId AND p.HistoryId=d.HistoryId WHERE s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId='0000000000000000' AND s.TxnId='0000000000000000' ORDER BY p.CollectSamplingTestDtlHistorId

empty_detail_result: 没有可关联的样本明细；父键映射尚待非空现场验证，不能将空结果当完整。

nonempty_history_checks.query: SELECT TOP 1 s.CollectSamplingDataHistoryId AS SummaryId,s.SamplingLotId,s.SampleTestId,s.TotalSamplesCompleted,s.TotalRejects,s.TotalPassedSamples,s.HistoryId,s.HistoryMainlineId,s.TxnId,h.HistoryId AS HeaderHistoryId,h.ContainerId,h.ContainerName,h.Comments,h.TxnType,h.TxnTypeName,h.TxnServiceName,h.TxnServiceSequence,h.ReversalStatus FROM CollectSamplingDataHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId ORDER BY s.HistoryMainlineId

SELECT TOP 1 s.ExecuteSamplingLotHistoryId AS SummaryId,s.SamplingCompleted,s.SamplingLotResult,s.HistoryId,s.HistoryMainlineId,s.TxnId,h.HistoryId AS HeaderHistoryId,h.ContainerId,h.ContainerName,h.Comments,h.TxnType,h.TxnTypeName,h.TxnServiceName,h.TxnServiceSequence,h.ReversalStatus FROM ExecuteSamplingLotHistory s INNER JOIN HistoryMainline h ON h.HistoryMainlineId=s.HistoryMainlineId AND h.TxnId=s.TxnId ORDER BY s.HistoryMainlineId
